environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API type) with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the API Gateway stage. The WebACL includes a rule group reference statement pointing to a CUSTOM rule group (not AWS managed) named 'corp-payload-inspection-rg' with priority 1. This rule group contains a single rule using a RegexPatternSet match condition on the request body that inspects base64-decoded content for byte sequences matching ZIP local file header signatures (PK\x03\x04) followed by path traversal patterns (../ or ..\ encoded in various forms). The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 418. The WebACL also has a secondary rule at priority 5 referencing AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY overridden to COUNT (not block), which may appear to weaken body inspection but does not affect the custom regex rule. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule group evaluates before any managed rules. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda with API Gateway REST API

waf_rules.name: corp-payload-inspection-rg
waf_rules.description: Custom regex rule inspecting decoded body for ZIP entries containing path traversal sequences

waf_rules.name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
waf_rules.description: Standard managed rules with body size check relaxed for large uploads
